info.title: RSVP Provider Catalog API
info.description: 2.0.0: real service (port 3005). Paths now include the gateway prefixes (/providers, /r) and /listings; bodies and responses are defined. GET /providers keeps the query contract of RSVPFrontend seo-web (category, city, verified, maxPriceMinor, availableOn, page, pageSize) and adds coverage, near and locale. Errors are RFC 9457 problems. Disclaimer: RSVP brokers contact, it does not deliver the service. 2.1.0 (additive): ProviderCard adds providerId, providerName, destinations, address and hours and GET /providers accepts ?slug=; GET /providers/mine; microsite profile (GET/PUT /providers/{id}/microsite, REQ-F28-02); verification documents with presigned upload to object storage (/providers/{id}/documents...); POST /providers/impressions returns {recorded, ignored}; POST /providers/{id}/quotes accepts anonymous requests only when the deployment enables them (captcha or open mode, with per-address and per-contact caps); GET /listings text search matches any word, accent-insensitively, by title, category or description. 2.2.0 (additive, back office, ADMIN only: 401 without token, 403 to any other role): GET/PUT /providers/admin/categories[/{code}], GET/PUT /providers/admin/geography[/{code}], GET /providers/admin/verification-queue, POST /providers/{providerId}/reject (reason required), POST /providers/{providerId}/suspend now takes {reason} (required when an administrator suspends; the owner may still pause its own provider), GET /providers/admin/moderation and POST /providers/admin/moderation/{id}/approve|reject, GET /providers/admin/metrics/leads, GET /providers/admin/summary. ProviderStatus gains REJECTED (a rejected provider may resubmit). Every decision is audited (actor, time, reason) and emits an outbox event. Inactive categories and cities disappear from the public lists. City coordinates were verified against GeoNames. 2.3.0 (additive): the provider-owned routes of the Nest runtime (/private/*, /catalog/*, /public/products*) and, later in the same version, GET/PUT /providers/{providerId}/notification-settings and the internal GET /internal/v1/providers/{providerId}/notification-profile (that addition did not bump the version; from 2.9.1 the contract version lock in packages/contracts-openapi/versions.lock.json refuses a content change without a version change). 2.4.0 (additive): listing categories and catalog photos. 2.9.0 (additive, A23): GET /listings/{listingId} exposes enabled destination types. WhatsApp links support an optional prefilled message. 2.9.1 (correction, no runtime change): removes GET/POST /, POST /{providerId}/verify, POST /{providerId}/listings, GET /{providerId}/calendar, POST /{providerId}/bookings and POST /{providerId}/quotes. The service never served those unprefixed paths (it serves the same operations under /providers/...), and they duplicated seven operationIds (searchProviders, registerProvider, verifyProvider, createListing, getProviderCalendar, requestBooking, requestQuote), which OpenAPI requires to be unique. 2.10.0 (B11, additive): the provider's quote inbox. GET /providers/{providerId}/quotes (newest first, keyset cursor) and GET /providers/{providerId}/quotes/{quoteId} with the contact the requester gave. Owner with the PROVIDER role only (administrators and other providers get 403), under the provider's row-level scope. 2.10.1 (correction, no runtime change): the /private/*, /catalog/* and /public/products* operations declare their own server http://localhost:8000/providers. The service has always served them under /providers (Nest controllers providers/private, providers/catalog and providers/public/products), and the gateway reaches them there; resolved against the global server they pointed to paths that answer 404. Path keys and operationIds are unchanged, so generated clients keep their types and only the base URL of these 18 operations moves. 2.11.0 (additive, A24; PR #42: partner creation moves to the admin panel; ADMIN only, every route calls requireAdmin in the service: 401 without token, 403 to any other role): partner intake (server-side draft) POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /providers/admin/intakes[/{intakeId}], its KYP documents (/documents, /complete, DELETE) and the atomic POST /providers/admin/intakes/{intakeId}/commit (Idempotency-Key) that creates the provider VERIFIED with origin ADMIN and KYP COMPLETE, moves the documents (review ACCEPTED), writes admin_audit provider.created-by-admin and enqueues provider.provider.registered.v2; partner administration GET /providers/admin/partners (server-side filters, sort, pagination), GET/PATCH /providers/admin/partners/{providerId} (If-Match), documents with review, kyp/complete, suspend, reactivate and change-owner (409 OWNER_CHANGE_UNAVAILABLE until F4), GET /providers/admin/documents/{documentId}/download (5-minute presigned URL, audited). Document kinds gain POWER_OF_ATTORNEY and BANK_CERTIFICATE and documents carry reviewStatus. The CI and the bank account are encrypted at rest and masked (****1234) in every response; only GET ...?reveal=ci returns the CI, and that read is audited. KYP_INCOMPLETE carries details.missing (list of failing kyp.<path> and documents.<KIND>); Problem.details stays an object. 3.0.0 (frente F8, A20): the provider has one state machine, the marketplace one (POST /providers/{providerId}/submit|verify|suspend|reject), which audits every decision and returns its reason to the owner (Provider.statusReason, statusChangedAt). The duplicated Nest lifecycle routes are retired (incompatible change, hence the major version): GET /private/providers/{providerId}/verification, POST /private/providers/{providerId}/verification-requests, GET /private/admin/providers/{providerId} and POST /private/admin/providers/{providerId}/verify|suspend. No client used them; the private registration POST /private/providers stays until phase 4 of the partner hand-over. Microsite.moderation tells the owner that a rejected microsite is unpublished and why. 3.1.0 (additive, A23; PR #69): GET /r/{listingId} is one redirector routed by the listing: destination is optional (absent = the primary destination: PRODUCT_PAGE of a product, otherwise the first stored and enabled one); every destination is checked against its whitelist when published and again when resolved (tel:+E.164, mailto:, https://wa.me/<number>, https://instagram.com, canonical https), so a stored target that no longer passes answers 404. 3.2.0 (additive, L4; PR #67): GET /providers/{providerId}/bookings and GET /providers/me/bookings are keyset pages ordered by (date, id): ?limit (1 to 100, default 50) and the opaque ?cursor of the previous page; the response adds nextCursor (null on the last page). Until 2.4.x both lists stopped at 200 bookings without saying so; a client that ignores nextCursor now sees a bounded first page and an explicit cursor instead of a silent cut. A malformed limit or cursor is 422 (INVALID_QUERY, INVALID_CURSOR). 3.3.0 (additive, A24/DPA-10; provisional version pending VERSIONES.md): partner requests. A signed-in user who owns no provider sends POST /providers/partner-requests (business name, category, department and city codes of /providers/categories and /providers/geo, WhatsApp or phone, message up to 1000 characters, contact consent), sees status and statusReason in GET /providers/partner-requests/mine and may withdraw an OPEN request (DELETE /providers/partner-requests/{requestId}, REJECTED with reason WITHDRAWN_BY_REQUESTER). One live (OPEN or IN_REVIEW) request per user (409 REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN), at most 3 in 30 days (429 REQUEST_LIMIT), never for a user who already owns a provider (409 ALREADY_PARTNER_OWNER). The administrator lists the queue (GET /providers/admin/partner-requests, with OPEN / IN_REVIEW counts for the tab badge), takes (OPEN -> IN_REVIEW), rejects with a mandatory reason, or converts a request (POST .../convert: one transaction opens a partner intake owned by the requester with identity, contact and coverage prefilled). Transitions take an optional If-Match version (409 PARTNER_REQUEST_VERSION_CONFLICT) and are audited. 3.4.0 (additive, R1 of the gift series: A28, A29, M23): GET /providers/categories accepts ?type=PRODUCT|SERVICE and keeps the categories that can hold that listing type (the ones typed that way plus the untyped ones, listingType null, which hold both); another value is 422 INVALID_QUERY. Creating or publishing a listing whose type differs from its category's listingType is 422 CATEGORY_TYPE_MISMATCH (details: type, category, categoryType); the database enforces the same rule. The legacy POST /private/providers/{providerId}/products keeps its closed problem catalogue and answers PROVIDER_VALIDATION (422) for a product in a SERVICE category. Eighteen PRODUCT categories of the gift catalogue are added as data (no schema change). ListingSummary (GET /listings, GET /listings/{listingId}) declares type as required with enum PRODUCT|SERVICE; the service always sent it, so consumers only gain a narrower type. Listings stored before the rule whose type does not match their category (a SERVICE in a PRODUCT category, or a PRODUCT in a SERVICE category) are not converted: a data migration hides them (published false) and marks them with hiddenReason CATEGORY_TYPE_MISMATCH in the provider's own listings (Listing.hiddenReason); existing gift reservations keep pointing at them. 3.5.0 (additive, R2 of the gift series: A30, L23): the product sheet of a marketplace PRODUCT (exact priceMinor, stock, giftIdeas, variants, delivery with city slugs, details, whatsappTemplate) with completeness and missing; GET and PATCH /providers/{providerId}/listings/{listingId} (If-Match, 428/409); POST /providers/{providerId}/listings takes Idempotency-Key and refuses imageUrl for a PRODUCT; POST .../duplicate; PUT /providers/admin/listings/{listingId}/featured (ADMIN); GET/PUT /providers/{providerId}/whatsapp-template; public GET /providers/gift-ideas; publishing a PRODUCT requires COMPLETE (422 LISTING_INCOMPLETE); GET /listings lists only eligible products; product photos (presigned upload signing Content-Length, complete, delete). BEHAVIOUR CHANGE (PF-6), with no change to existing shapes: a client of 3.4.0 that sends imageUrl for a PRODUCT now gets 422 IMAGE_URL_NOT_ALLOWED, publishing a PRODUCT without a complete sheet is 422 LISTING_INCOMPLETE, and GET /listings no longer lists incomplete or hidden products; the provider portal must move to 3.5.0 in the same deployment (BE R2 and FE R2 go together). Product texts, delivery conditions, variant labels, photo altText and the WhatsApp template refuse phones and web addresses (422 CONTACT_IN_TEXT with details {field, fragment}; decision 7). Listing (owner view) adds incompleteReason OWN_CATALOG_NO_SHEET to products of the own gift catalog (SNAPSHOT_V1), which have completeness INCOMPLETE and no editable sheet yet. The photo cap of 5 per product counts the photos of its variants too. Decoration and invitations categories have gift ideas (provider migration 20261125000400). ProductSheet.adminHiddenReason carries the administrator's text while a product is HIDDEN_BY_ADMIN; Listing.hiddenReason stays the platform's CATEGORY_TYPE_MISMATCH (3.4.0). 3.6.0 (additive, R3 of the gift series: A32, M25, M26): public GET /providers/gift-ideas/recommendations (Cache-Control: public, max-age=60; Vary: Accept-Language) answers, for the event type and city of a celebration, the gift ideas of that event type (every idea when the type has none, or exactly the ideas requested) that have eligible products, in the approved table order, each with productCount, priceRange and up to 12 product cards, paginated per idea with offset and nextOffset; ideas without eligible products are not sent. Eligible product: VERIFIED provider below its monthly lead cap, PRODUCT published, COMPLETE, not hidden, stock other than OUT_OF_STOCK. Order inside an idea: featured, delivers to the event city, catalog score (location tier of the listing against the event city, then plan), shorter lead time, older. The card carries destination types only, never URLs. GET /listings applies the same eligibility to products (it also drops OUT_OF_STOCK products and providers over their lead cap), accepts ?city= (products that deliver there first, each product then carrying deliversToCity), matches words of 1 or 2 letters as whole words (never in descriptions; articles ignored) and also searches the names of the product's gift ideas. GET /listings/{listingId} adds giftEligible (the same predicate) and keeps answering 200 for a published listing that is not eligible, so gifts already in a list still read it; Gift decides on add. Notes of 3.6.0: the recommendation endpoint accepts only eventType, city, ideas, productsPerIdea, offset and locale, and any other parameter (?_=1 included) is 422 INVALID_QUERY; locale outside es-BO and en-US is 422 INVALID_QUERY; ideas takes at most 25 entries counted as sent; an unknown eventType falls back to scope ALL_IDEAS; GET /listings orders by city before relevance (decision pending). BEHAVIOUR CHANGE (PF-6), with no change to existing shapes: a client of 3.5.0 sees that GET /listings no longer lists OUT_OF_STOCK products or products of providers that reached their monthly lead cap; a search word of 1 or 2 letters now finds (as a whole word, never in descriptions) where it used to find nothing; the search also matches the names of the product's gift ideas; ?city= changes the order of the items (products that deliver there first); and a write that contradicts the stock rule below is refused with 422 STOCK_MISMATCH_DEFAULT_VARIANT (a stock sent with variants that differs from the default variant's, or a PATCH of stock alone that contradicts it), which 3.5.0 accepted. Stock rule (review B1): with variants, the stock of a product is the stock of its default variant, as the price is. A stock sent with variants that differs from the default variant's is 422 STOCK_MISMATCH_DEFAULT_VARIANT (details: field, defaultVariantStock), a PATCH of stock alone that contradicts the stored default variant is the same 422, a product whose stock contradicts its default variant is never COMPLETE (missing STOCK), and a product whose default variant is OUT_OF_STOCK is not eligible. Provider migration 20261126000400 aligns the stock of rows stored before the rule, except products marked OUT_OF_STOCK whose default variant is in stock: those stay unchanged (not eligible) and are flagged to moderation (LISTING_STOCK_REVIEW_NEEDED). GET /listings?city= with an empty value is treated as absent. GET /listings/{listingId} declares giftEligible as required (it was always sent; schema ListingDetail). 3.7.0 (additive, R6a of the gift series: D-10 #31 and #32, plan §5.9): GET /r/{listingId} keeps answering 302 for every click and records more invalid (non-billable) leads. Lead.invalidReason adds PREVIEW (surface=PREVIEW, the new preview surface of the portal and of moderation), NOT_ELIGIBLE (a PRODUCT that is not COMPLETE or that an administrator hid), PROVIDER_SELF (the visitor owns the listing's provider) and HOST_OR_PLANNER (the visitor is a member of the celebration: host, organizer or collaborator); dup (DUPLICATE) and bot (BOT) are unchanged. PROVIDER_SELF and HOST_OR_PLANNER are decided only from the new optional query parameter ctx, a short-lived token signed by Gift List (gift-list listGiftItems leadContext) and bound to the click's celebrationId; a missing, forged, expired or foreign ctx is ignored and never an error. A GIFT_LIST click is billed at most once per 24 h for the same visitor, listing and destination (configurable, never shorter than the provider's dedupeMinutes; a repeat on any other surface inside that window is also a duplicate). POST /providers/impressions does not accept PREVIEW. 3.8.0 (R5 of the gift series: A31, M27; additive): the redirector resolves the WhatsApp message of a PRODUCT on the server. GET /r/{listingId}?destination=WHATSAPP answers 302 to https://wa.me/<number>?text=<message> (text encoded with %20, at most 1000 characters before encoding, no tracking parameters), where the message is the product's whatsappTemplate, else the provider's, else the platform default (R2 stores them, by language), with {proveedor}, {producto}, {version}, {precio}, {cantidad}, {celebracion}, {fecha}, {ciudad} and {entrega} filled by the server: product, version and its price now, provider name and quantity from the catalog and the query; the celebration's title, event date and the host's delivery notes from the public views of Celebration and Gift List (read by celebrationSlug, which needs celebrationId and is ignored without it, and only if it belongs to that celebration; cached 5 minutes); the city from the city slug. A variable without a source is removed without leaving double spaces or empty brackets. Nothing about the guest is ever part of the message: there is no variable for the guest and guestId, name, phone or text parameters are never read into it. The new optional parameters giftItemId, variant, quantity (a positive integer, cut to 200: 422 INVALID_QUANTITY when it is not one) and celebrationSlug are validated (422 INVALID_LEAD_CONTEXT) and giftItemId, variant and quantity are stored with the lead; giftItemId is never shown to the provider. The redirect never fails because the celebration's views are down: the message goes without those variables. Other destinations, and the WhatsApp destination of a SERVICE, redirect as before. New public operation getCurrentPrices (GET /listings/current-prices?ids=, at most 50 ids): the price charged now of each ELIGIBLE product (the predicate of GET /listings and giftEligible: published, COMPLETE, not hidden, in stock, VERIFIED provider under its lead cap) and of each of its versions, so a gift list can show the current price instead of the one copied when the gift was added; listings that are not public are absent. 3.9.0 (R6b of the gift series: D-10 #33 to #35, M34, M-1, M-2, A35; additive except where noted): GET /providers/admin/leads/report and /report.csv (ADMIN only) give the monthly lead report per provider, product and button: valid and invalid leads by reason and the total billable by billing model, no personal data; the CSV neutralises spreadsheet formulas. GET /providers/{providerId}/leads/report is the same report for one provider (owner or admin), and GET /providers/{providerId}/leads takes the filters month, listingId and destination. A35 (privacy fix, still additive): Lead.context is now a closed object (surface, locale, device, country, city, eventType) without celebrationId or guestId, and Lead gains listingTitle, eventType, city, surface and device. POST /providers/{providerId}/lead-context issues the signed ctx of the portal: PROVIDER_OWNER (M-1: the owner's clicks are always PROVIDER_SELF) and PREVIEW of one listing (M-2: surface=PREVIEW only counts with it; without it the click is evaluated normally and recorded as PUBLIC_SITE). GET /r/{listingId}: M34, the sessionId query parameter is ignored (the billing key is always the server's hash of address and user agent) and eventType is a new optional parameter. 3.10.0 (R7 of the gift series: plan §5.10, decision 28; additive): the provider's own product responses (GET/PATCH /providers/{providerId}/listings/{listingId}) add giftAvailability {available, reason, unavailableVariants}: whether gift lists can still offer the product and why not (the first that applies of HIDDEN_BY_ADMIN, PROVIDER_SUSPENDED, PROVIDER_REJECTED, PROVIDER_NOT_VERIFIED, UNPUBLISHED, INCOMPLETE and OUT_OF_STOCK) and the ids of the versions out of stock. The same change is announced by the event provider.listing.availability-changed.v1 (AsyncAPI 1.29.0) to Gift List, which hides the gift from guests and tells the host with replacements. It is derived and read only: nothing a client sends changes it.

post.summary: Step 1 of 3: register a product photo and get a presigned PUT URL (owner/admin)
post.description: R2 (A30). Flow: (1) this call; (2) PUT the image bytes to upload.url with upload.headers directly against the object store, no bearer token; the URL also signs Content-Length, so the body must be exactly `bytes` long (declare the file's real size; the store answers 403 to any other length); (3) POST .../photos/{photoId}/complete. Only a marketplace PRODUCT takes photos (not SERVICE, not the SNAPSHOT_V1 gift catalog). JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC up to 5 MB; at most 5 photos per product and 3 per variant; a per-provider storage quota (PROVIDER_MEDIA_MAX_BYTES_PER_PROVIDER, 200 MB by default) reserves the declared size until the upload completes or is abandoned (1 hour). The object key is built from ids only. With Idempotency-Key, repeating the same request returns the same photo (200), with a fresh upload link while it is still PENDING_UPLOAD and upload null afterwards; the same key with another listing, type, size, variantId or altText is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Another provider gets 403 whether the listing exists or not.

post.summary: Step 3 of 3: confirm the upload and queue the photo for processing (idempotent)
post.description: Checks the stored object: present (else 409 UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND), 1 byte up to the declared size, and its first 32 bytes are those of the declared type (JPEG FFD8FF, PNG signature, RIFF....WEBP, or an ISO-BMFF ftyp box with a HEIC brand). Otherwise the object is deleted and the photo turns REJECTED with rejectReason UNREADABLE (422 PHOTO_MISMATCH; it no longer counts against the limits or the quota and is removed after 7 days). Answers 202 with the photo QUEUED; repeated later it answers 202 with the current state (also REJECTED). The worker checks the type of the original again before decoding it, so an object replaced after this call with the still valid upload link is REJECTED UNREADABLE. The photo worker then renders WebP renditions thumb (160 px), card (480 px) and full (1280 px; longest side, never enlarged) without EXIF or GPS, deletes the original and leaves the photo READY, or REJECTED with UNREADABLE, HEIC_UNSUPPORTED (HEIC is converted on the client; the server cannot decode HEVC), TOO_MANY_PIXELS (more than 60 MP) or PROCESSING_FAILED (3 attempts).

202.description: Queued for the photo worker (or already processed)

404.description: PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND or PHOTO_NOT_FOUND (unknown, of another listing, or being deleted)

409.description: UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: nothing was uploaded yet or the link expired

422.description: PHOTO_MISMATCH: not the declared image type or larger than declared; the file was deleted and the photo is REJECTED (UNREADABLE)

503.description: MEDIA_STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED (no media bucket in this environment) or STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE

post.description: Decision (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-05): quotes may be anonymous only when PROVIDER_ANON_QUOTES is `captcha` (default when a captcha verifier is configured) or `open` (local development). Anonymous requests need contact.email, are limited to 5 per hour per client address (429 + Retry-After) and 3 per day per contact e-mail and provider (429 QUOTE_LIMIT_REACHED), reject a filled honeypot `website` (422 QUOTE_REJECTED) and, in captcha mode, a valid captchaToken (403 CAPTCHA_FAILED). get.description: One partner redirector (A23). The own gift-catalog products (H05B) resolve their PRODUCT_PAGE through the H05B boundary: the stored validated officialProductUrl with controlled UTM and correlationId, an anonymous nonbillable click (valid:false, reason unassessed) and its provider.lead.marked-invalid.v1 outbox committed atomically before the 302; a suspended provider records the click (reason suspended) and answers 404 without Location; unknown or duplicate query keys (url, next, redirect...) answer 422. Every other listing and destination (OFFICIAL_SITE, LANDING, WHATSAPP, PHONE, EMAIL, INSTAGRAM, PRODUCT_PAGE) is resolved by the marketplace redirector: the lead (valid, or invalid dup/bot) and its event are stored in one transaction before the 302 (never 301). Only a destination stored on the listing, enabled in its lead configuration and still passing its whitelist can become the Location; anything else is 404. tel: and mailto: targets are returned intact; https targets get utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and correlationId. Failure to persist the click or its outbox answers 503 and never 302. Since 3.8.0 (R5) a PRODUCT's WHATSAPP redirect carries the provider's message in the text parameter of the wa.me link (see the API description); no query parameter can add text to it.

PartnerKyp.description: Bolivian KYP. Drafts accept any subset; the commit requires personType, legalName, nit (7-12 digits), legalAddress, representative (ciNumber digits, ciExtension of the closed list, ciExpiresOn not in the past -> CI_EXPIRED), seprecRegistration for UNIPERSONAL and JURIDICA, companyType for JURIDICA. Required documents: NATURAL TAX_ID, IDENTITY, ADDRESS_PROOF; UNIPERSONAL adds BUSINESS_REGISTRATION; JURIDICA adds BUSINESS_REGISTRATION and POWER_OF_ATTORNEY unless representativeInRegistration=true; BANK_CERTIFICATE when bankAccount is given.
